content:
This is the first public changelogs in this blog! We are so glad with it 😊
Anyways, this update isn’t big update. but also, this is preparation for the Replay v3.0 Update. Focused on server storage for replays especially.
Changes Replay storage update As we’ve mentioned in the last maintenance announcement, We’ve changed a lot of backend stuffs for the replay storage, Due to this change, every past match replays are deleted from the server. However, you can still access on Weekly Race replays. Replay expiration time has been extended from 3 days to 7 days. Ranked mode match replays in the Top 50 leaderboard of each season will now be stored as no expiration time. You can no longer download or watch more than 5 replays per minute Updated tab selections in ranked settings screen. Added more splash texts. Bug Reports Please join our Discord Server to report any issues!
